company_name: Fraunhofer ENAS- Institute for Electronic Nano Systems
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Fraunhofer ENAS focuses on smart systems integration using micro and nano technologies, which are relevant to semiconductor applications but not directly involved in semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Fraunhofer ENAS is a research institute specializing in the development of smart systems and their integration for various applications, leveraging micro and nano technologies. They support projects across the entire value chain, from concept through design and technology development to prototype testing.
capabilities: Development of high-performance sensors and actuator systems
Advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration of electronic components
Simulation and data analysis using artificial intelligence

regional_presence.Germany: Fraunhofer ENAS is located in Erfurt and Chemnitz, Germany, focusing on microtechnology innovations.
